name: go
description: Idiomatic Go design and engineering as a routed, gated workflow (digraph of focused chunks + rubric + domain reference leaves), with a deterministic correctness baseline enforced via hooks. Merges the go-engineering rulebook and spf13/go-skills domain knowledge (Cobra/Viper, releases, Wails, safe file ops, modern-Go currency). Pushes simplicity and kills over-abstraction.
